# 事件、选项与调度句柄

[API 任务入口](../../index.md) · [公开模块](../index.md)

事件构造器声明游戏内容并返回带作用域的事件句柄。把句柄保存在普通常量中，就能在另一个效果回调内调用 `country.schedule(handle, delay)`；不会在编译时触发游戏事件。`EventSpec` 描述整场事件，`EventOption` / `Option` 描述玩家选择，二者与返回句柄在本页连续列出。

`trigger` 决定事件条件，`immediate` 是触发时立即执行的效果，`options` 是可选回答；`isTriggeredOnly` 适合由国策、决议或其他事件明确安排的事件。`title`、`description` 和选项 `name` 应填写本地化键，文本内容放在本地化文件中。

## 使用示例

```ts
import { CountryEvent, Option } from "krieg-lang/hoi4";

export const aid = CountryEvent({
  id: "reconstruction.1",
  title: "RECONSTRUCTION_TITLE",
  description: "RECONSTRUCTION_DESC",
  isTriggeredOnly: true,
  options: [Option({
    name: "ACCEPT_AID",
    effects: country => country.effects.addPoliticalPower(25),
  })],
});
// 在国家效果回调中：country.schedule(aid, { days: 2 });
```

## CountryEvent() { #countryevent }

> **CountryEvent**&lt;`Id` *extends* `string`&gt;(`spec`: [`EventSpec`](#eventspec)&lt;[`CountryScope`](country-scope.md#countryscope)&gt; & `object`): [`EventDefinition`](#eventdefinition)&lt;`"country"`, `Id`&gt;

Defined in: [src/sdk/index.ts:251](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/index.ts#L251)

Declare a country event and return its typed handle. Keep the handle when scheduling from another definition: TypeScript checks the receiver scope and preserves the literal event ID.

### Example { #countryevent-section-example }

```ts

  id: "council.001", hidden: true, isTriggeredOnly: true,
  immediate: country => country.effects.addPoliticalPower(10),
});
// In a country effect callback: country.schedule(grant, { days: 2 }).
```

## EventDefinition&lt;S *extends* `"country"` \| `"state"`, Id *extends* `string` = `string`&gt; { #eventdefinition }

Defined in: [src/sdk/gameplay.ts:82](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/gameplay.ts#L82)

An event declaration that can be scheduled only in its recipient scope.

### Remarks { #eventdefinition-section-remarks }

Country and news events both have country recipients. State events
require a state recipient. The literal ID remains available for native APIs.

## EventDelay { #eventdelay }

Defined in: [src/sdk/gameplay.ts:99](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/gameplay.ts#L99)

Delay before an event is delivered. All fields add together; a month is 30 days.

### Remarks { #eventdelay-section-remarks }

Random fields add a uniformly sampled value from zero through the
supplied maximum. Values must be non-negative compile-time integers. An empty
delay delivers the event immediately. Delayed events recheck their trigger
when delivered, and their timer pauses while the receiving country is absent.

## EventIdentifier&lt;Id *extends* `string`&gt; { #eventidentifier }

> **EventIdentifier**&lt;`Id` *extends* `string`&gt; = `string` *extends* `Id` ? `Id` : `Id` *extends* `` `${string}.${string}` `` ? [`DecimalDigits`](#decimaldigits)&lt;[`LastEventPart`](#lasteventpart)&lt;`Id`&gt;&gt; *extends* `true` ? `Id` : `never` : `never`

Defined in: [src/sdk/gameplay.ts:68](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/gameplay.ts#L68)

Validate a literal event ID's decimal suffix without losing leading zeros.

### Type Parameters { #eventidentifier-section-type-parameters }

| Type Parameter |
| ------ |
| <a id="eventidentifier-type-parameter-id"></a> `Id` *extends* `string` |

### Remarks { #eventidentifier-section-remarks }

Dotted namespaces are supported. Negative, hexadecimal and exponent
suffixes are rejected by TypeScript. The compiler additionally validates the
namespace, warns about numeric namespace overflow, and checks duplicate IDs.
Widened strings remain usable by annotated specs and source helpers; the
compiler validates their statically evaluated value before emitting an event.
